decision_units.goal: 完成 Chapter 12.1：定义五类运行期 observation（scope_out_of_bounds、policy_changed、controlled_file_changed、high_risk_command、evidence_missing）的版本化严格契约与纯解析/类型层，绑定当前 task/base/subject/Policy/source 并仅携带最小安全摘要；覆盖未知字段、非法绑定和敏感/自由命令载荷的 fail-closed 测试，不实现决策映射、事件持久化、CLI、Hook 或 CI adapter。
planned_actions: Define one closed version 1.0 observation contract for the five Chapter 12.1 observation kinds and four declared sources
Bind each fact to task, base commit, subject commit and active Policy digest with one kind-specific minimal safe summary
Add immutable Python types and a pure parser/serializer that delegates structural validation to the registered contract
Reject unknown fields, invalid bindings, unsafe repository paths, free-form command payloads and kind/summary mismatches without echoing sensitive input
Add canonical template and valid/invalid fixtures plus focused contract and parser tests
Project only Chapter 12.1 progress and document the boundary for later decision, persistence, CLI, Hook and CI tasks
